values.note: Open Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day.

season.source: http://www.sheridanny.org/sheridan-bay-park.html ('The Park is open from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations through the park caretaker by phone ('leave a message, I will return your call') for nightly, weekly or seasonal stays; taken from March 1 for the current season only. Long-term stays (3 weeks or more) are paid in full by the first Friday.

booking.source: http://www.sheridanny.org/sheridan-bay-park.html ('Reservations may be made for nightly, weekly, or even seasonal camping visitors'; caretaker 716-785-8044) + http://www.sheridanny.org/uploads/1/4/5/1/145112937/rates_reservation_and_pavillion_rental_information.pdf ('We start taking reservations on March 1st each year through the Park Manager ... no reservations made in any given year for the following year's season'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: http://www.sheridanny.org/uploads/1/4/5/1/145112937/parkrules.pdf (park rules, headed 2018: 'Water is provided at individual sites for the convenience of our campers'), read 2026-10-21

note: Town of Sheridan park on the Lake Erie shore east of Dunkirk, off NY-5. Small campground; sites with electric, small-boat access to the lake. Swimming is prohibited at the beach (no lifeguards). --Claude
summary: Town pages confirm the caretaker phone, phone reservations (nightly/weekly/seasonal, from March 1), Memorial Day-Labor Day season and water at each site; they post no nightly rate and say nothing on electric amperage or showers.
flags: No nightly rate is posted anywhere on the Town of Sheridan's pages (the 'Rates, Reservations' PDF gives only the $2 overnight-visitor and $10 extra-tent charges); nights are sold by phone through the caretaker alongside weekly and seasonal stays, with no count of seasonal vs nightly sites. Only aggregators report a rate (Campendium: $40 with 20-amp, reported 2026-07). If the long-stay test 2 (a posted nightly rate) is applied to town parks, this one fails it; otherwise fine.
